name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal S_n)=n$ while $\mathrm{LS}(\mathcal S_n)=\log(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the two-concept class $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, $\mathrm{LS}(\mathcal T_n)=\log(n+1)$ while $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal T_n)=2$.
proof: The canonical Singleton and Trivial-Concept value calculations provide the two opposite unbounded gaps.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Monotonic co-VC Dimension and Log Shattering of Singletons and Trivial Concepts.
